name: pverrw
execution_status: NOT RUN: host build/contract checks only
description: General P54C VERR/VERW queries: fixed r/m16 source, only ZF changes, no GPR/source/descriptor writes, descriptor type and CPL/RPL rules, conforming-code exemption, P-bit independence, GDT/LDT boundaries, precise explicit/implicit read faults, and real/V86 rejection.

variants.purpose: PM32 register/memory; 66/67/both lengths; type/RPL/P0/null/GDT OOB/LDT including index0 and OOB; no accessed-bit write
CPL3 versus DPL0/1/3; readable conforming DPL0 bypasses CPL and RPL; code is never writable
Exactly two-byte selector at page end succeeds; absent/crossing selector #PF0 CR2=21000; both old ZF1/ZF0 and all GPRs preserved
Valid selector's high descriptor dword #PF0 CR2=21000; no early ZF change; null/OOB rejects without implicit descriptor read
Real-mode register/memory VERR/VERW #UD; 3/4/5/8-byte lengths, saved IP/CS/flags/GPR/stack precision
V86 #UD before unmapped DS2000:1000 operand; saved VM/IOPL/flags/GPR/stack/selectors and prefix lengths
PM16 register and memory fixed-word source with 66/67/both; 3/4/5/6/8/9-byte lengths

coverage_gaps: No TF/data-breakpoint trap witness yet; existing S_DQUERY bare retirement must not be assumed debug-qualified.
No explicit source #GP/#SS null/limit/privilege cases yet; these must retain existing source-access enforcement.
No illegal LOCK query witness yet; decoder rejection must be preserved.
Host build and static assertions do not prove QEMU/RTL execution, cold Win95 causality, desktop, or standard-suite acceptance.
